finding.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
finding.summary: an analyst-authored filter expression persisted on the report definition is passed unmodified into Apache Commons JEXL's engine.createExpression(), evaluated by a JexlEngine built via new JexlBuilder().create() with no JexlSandbox configured, so the expression has unrestricted access to any class or method reachable from the JexlContext
